key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A5E8
name: dequeue_and_dispatch_command
description: Takes the next byte from a 32-slot ring buffer and dispatches on its value. Each case issues a fixed sequence of library calls through a stored function pointer using stored 16-bit values as arguments, and one case first clamps a negative stored value to zero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A7F0
name: dispatch_command_from_register
description: Dispatches on the value held in the data register instead of reading a queue. It runs the same case sequence as the queue dispatcher, making library calls through a stored function pointer and clamping a negative stored value in one case.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A870
name: enqueue_byte_if_not_full
description: Appends the byte passed in to a 32-slot ring buffer when the buffer is not full, advancing the write index. When the buffer is full it leaves the buffer and index unchanged.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A89E
name: draw_string_with_length
description: Measures the length of a zero-terminated string, then makes one library call with fixed numeric arguments, a second call with two fixed values, and finally passes the string and its length to a library routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A8B6
name: invoke_library_setup_sequence
description: Makes three library calls in order: a seven-argument call using a library base value read from a global, a two-argument call, and a call with no arguments. The base value comes from a global variable.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A8F8
name: pass_string_with_length
description: Measures the length of a zero-terminated string and passes the string pointer and that length to one routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A910
name: self_recursive_call
description: Contains only a call to itself followed by a return, so each invocation calls itself again with no base case.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A922
name: wrap_text_into_lines
description: Copies a zero-terminated string into a line buffer, starting a new line at a space or carriage return or when the line passes about 37 characters. A percent sign expands to an entry from an indexed pointer table, and each finished line is passed to the output routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A942
name: resume_text_wrap_frame_loop
description: Continues the text-wrapping loop with its position kept in a stack frame, copying characters into a line buffer and passing finished lines to the output routine. A percent sign pulls in an entry from the indexed pointer table.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A97C
name: resume_text_wrap_after_char
description: Re-enters the text-wrapping loop after one character has been consumed, then continues filling lines and passing finished lines to the output routine. Percent signs are expanded from the indexed pointer table.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A9AE
name: wrap_text_break_on_return
description: Text-wrapping loop that flushes the current line and passes it to the output routine when it reaches a carriage return, then continues. Percent signs are expanded from the indexed pointer table.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A9B0
name: flush_char_then_wrap_text
description: Writes one pending character into the line buffer, then continues the text-wrapping loop. Finished lines go to the output routine and percent signs expand from the indexed pointer table.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A9F6
name: wrap_text_with_inline_expansion
description: Text-wrapping routine that terminates and emits the current line on a carriage return or when the line is too long. It expands percent signs inline from the indexed pointer table.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AA20
name: return_without_action
description: An empty routine whose pseudo-code is a bare return with no operations.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AA28
name: wrap_text_from_string_index
description: Skips a count of zero-terminated strings in a fixed text table, then runs the text-wrapping loop from that point and passes finished lines to the output routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AA32
name: wrap_second_table_text
description: Skips a count of zero-terminated strings in a second fixed text table, then runs the text-wrapping loop from there and passes finished lines to the output routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AA3C
name: wrap_text_after_skipping_strings
description: Skips a count of zero-terminated strings starting at a given pointer, then runs the text-wrapping loop from there and passes finished lines to the output routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AA56
name: print_table_entry_with_separators
description: Outputs the entry selected by an indexed pointer table, then a shared global string, then the caller's argument, then the shared global string again.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AAAA
name: print_table_entry_then_argument
description: Outputs the entry selected by an indexed pointer table, then a shared global string, then the caller's argument.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AAE6
name: print_indexed_table_entry
description: Outputs the entry selected by an indexed pointer table through the output routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AB06
name: initialise_record_and_copy_block
description: Stores a pointer to a sub-record and calls three library functions on the record, one of them copying a 32-byte block, then sets a state byte to 2. It also makes one routine call before those steps.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AB70
name: select_second_state_record
description: Points a state field at a second record, stores a fixed 16-bit value in a control word, calls two routines, and sets a state byte to 3.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AB92
name: sweep_values_down_by_five
description: Loops 21 times from 100 down to 0 in steps of five, calling a routine with the current value and a fixed buffer address, then calling a library function with 1 on each pass.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:ABC4
name: sweep_values_up_by_five
description: Loops from 0 up to 100 in steps of five, calling a routine with the current value and a fixed buffer address, then calling a library function with 1 on each pass.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:ABFA
name: clear_record_position_fields
description: Zeroes two 16-bit fields of the record reached through a global pointer, then calls one routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AC1A
name: issue_parameter_call_sequence
description: Copies a 32-bit value between two globals and then makes a fixed sequence of calls passing small constants, a table-derived index, and values read from globals.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AC9C
name: pack_entry_fields_within_limit
description: Reads values through a library call and stores them as 16-bit and 32-bit fields in a buffer at offsets the library returns, using an entry from a three-byte table. It issues a transfer call only while a running total stays within a fixed limit, then advances that total.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AE0C
name: fill_slot_from_template
description: Selects a 56-byte slot by index and calls a library function on it when its state is two. It then copies a 14-longword template into the slot, sets its two position fields from shifted arguments, marks it as state two, and passes it to a routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AE8E
name: copy_template_into_fixed_record
description: Copies a 14-longword template from a global pointer into a fixed record, sets two fields to zero and nine, then passes the record to a library function.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AEBA
name: call_through_and_return
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns, with no other operations.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AEC6
name: submit_table_entry_record
description: Calls a library function on a fixed record, clears a word field in it, then passes five values from an 18-byte table entry selected by the argument to a routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AF40
name: call_routine_unless_slot_done
description: Returns early when the current slot is in state two and a library call on it returns zero. Otherwise it calls a routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:AF66
name: load_song_data_blocks
description: Opens the file named by a global string, reads size-prefixed blocks up to 28 entries and a fixed byte limit, and records each block's offset in a table. Each block's data is read into a buffer before the file is closed.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B012
name: setup_display_when_flag_clear
description: When a flag byte is zero, it calls a library function with a fixed value, sets up a display structure with fixed width and height values, and calls two library functions with the given arguments. If a further check returns zero, it calls two more routines.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B0A0
name: draw_strip_rows_from_tables
description: Loops over 22 rows of tables, drawing vertical runs and strips through library calls with computed offsets and widths. It calls a library function with a row's table byte when that byte is nonzero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B364
name: check_code_equals_space
description: Calls a library function for a code, stores a flag recording whether the code equals the ASCII space value 32, and returns the same result.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B386
name: copy_bytes_to_new_allocation
description: If the source address is above a fixed threshold, it allocates a new buffer of the given length through a library call and copies that many bytes into it. Otherwise it returns the source pointer unchanged.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B3CC
name: draw_quad_with_winding_flags
description: Computes a quadrilateral from two sets of four corner offsets read from a table entry. It sets winding flags from cross-product signs, then draws the quad's edges through library calls when a 100-by-100 buffer is available.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B70E
name: set_state_and_call_tables
description: Sets a state word to two, passes a fixed 128-byte length and two table-selected values to routines, then copies the state word into another field when it exceeds three.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B770
name: copy_table_entry_into_slot
description: Copies a 16-bit value from a 22-byte table entry selected by the argument into a fixed slot. It stores that entry's second value plus ten beside it, writes the second argument into a byte field, and sets a flag byte to 1.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B7B2
name: set_record_state_by_index
description: Finds a record through a table lookup whose table is chosen by a flag bit. It sets the record's state byte to 29 when that byte is 15, otherwise it stores the argument byte in the field after it.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B7FA
name: set_record_state_from_word
description: Finds a record through a word index into a table, then applies the same update: a state byte of 15 becomes 29, otherwise the argument byte is stored in the following field.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B828
name: store_byte_to_offset
description: Stores the byte held in a data register into the memory location five bytes past the address register pointer.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B834
name: spawn_points_and_scan_list
description: Spawns up to ten new entries at random positions from a library call when a count condition holds, each with a type index from 0 to 15. It then walks a record list and adds or updates entries for records inside a fixed rectangle, calling routines when an entry type changes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B884
name: spawn_ten_points_then_scan
description: Creates ten entries at random positions from a library call, each with a type index from 0 to 15, then walks a record list and adds or updates entries for records inside a fixed rectangle. It calls routines when the type of a new entry differs from the last one handled.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:B98E
name: scan_record_list_for_entries
description: Walks a list of six-byte records and, for those inside a fixed rectangle, updates the current entry or adds a new one. It calls routines when a record's type differs from the last one handled.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BA8E
name: resume_record_list_scan
description: Resumes the record-list scan partway through its loop body, advancing the record pointer and count, then updating or adding entries for records inside the rectangle and calling routines on a type change.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BA92
name: scan_record_list_with_skip
description: Walks a list of six-byte records, skipping those outside a fixed rectangle, and updates or adds entries for the rest. It calls routines on a type change and sets a flag when one specific pair of record bytes is seen.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BB3E
name: scan_record_list_flag_update
description: Continues the six-byte record-list scan, writing a new entry's fields when an in-rectangle record is added. It sets a flag for one specific pair of record bytes and calls routines when a record's type changes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BBAE
name: scan_record_list_entry_fill
description: Finishes filling a new list entry with state 13, or 15 for one record type, and copies the record's position into it. It then continues the scan with the same rectangle and type-change checks.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BBE8
name: scan_record_list_add_fresh
description: Walks a list of six-byte records and adds a fresh entry for each in-rectangle record not yet tracked, choosing its subtype from a three-way test on the type byte. It calls routines when a record's type differs from the last one handled.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BC5A
name: scan_record_list_subtype_fill
description: Walks a list of six-byte records and tracks in-rectangle records, setting a subtype byte to 0 for type five and 1 otherwise. It calls routines when a record's type changes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BC70
name: scan_record_list_sets_subtype
description: Walks a list of six-byte records and tracks in-rectangle records, setting the entry subtype to 2 for type six, 0 for type five and 1 otherwise. It calls routines when a type changes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BCB2
name: return_without_action
description: An empty routine whose pseudo-code is a bare return with no operations.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BCE6
name: prompt_and_match_three_words
description: Repeatedly picks one of three pending strings with a library random call, reads a typed line of up to nine printable characters with backspace editing, and compares it with the chosen string. It returns zero on a mismatch, removes each matched entry, and returns one after three matches.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BD88
name: match_typed_word_loop
description: Loop form of the typed-line matcher that reads characters with backspace editing until carriage return, then compares the entered text with the chosen pending string. It returns zero on a mismatch and one after three matches.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BD98
name: typed_word_match_entry
description: Alternative entry into the typed-line matcher that appends a printable character to the line buffer and reads the next key. On carriage return it compares the text with the pending string and returns zero on a mismatch or one after three matches.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BDC8
name: compare_typed_text_and_advance
description: Compares the typed line with the selected pending string, clears the entry on a match and counts it, then selects a new pending string. It returns zero on a mismatch, one after three matches, and otherwise goes back to reading keys.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BDEA
name: compare_line_buffer_to_pending
description: Compares the stored line buffer with a pending string and returns zero on a mismatch. On a match it clears the entry and counts it, returning one after three matches, otherwise it selects the next pending string and reads keys.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BDEC
name: read_line_and_match_pending
description: Chooses a pending string at random, prompts and reads a line with backspace editing, then compares the typed text with it. It returns zero on a mismatch and one after three matches.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BE0C
name: run_paired_library_calls
description: Calls three library functions through a library base held in a register, then makes two pairs of calls through a second library base read from a global pointer. The entries are fixed library offsets.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BE70
name: call_and_store_nonzero_result
description: Calls a routine with two arguments and stores its result in a global. If the result is nonzero it passes that result to another routine, then returns it.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BE9E
name: acquire_df0_handle_checked
description: Calls a library function with the text df0: and the value minus two, and stores the returned handle. If the handle is nonzero it checks one field of the handle's structure against 230 before calling a routine on it, then returns the handle.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BEFA
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The bytes at this location decode as invalid instructions, so the routine contains only a halt marker and no real operations.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BEFE
name: wait_for_flag_then_clear
description: Polls a flag byte up to 300 times, calling a routine with the value five on each pass to wait. When the flag is nonzero it clears the flag and returns one, otherwise it returns zero after the limit.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BF08
name: poll_flag_with_timeout
description: Checks a flag byte, and if it is clear calls a routine with the value five and counts the pass, up to 300 passes. It returns one and clears the flag when it is set, or zero when the limit is reached.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BF18
name: poll_flag_until_timeout
description: Waits through repeated calls to a routine with the value five, counting passes up to 300. It clears the flag and returns one when the flag becomes nonzero, or returns zero when the count passes the limit.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BF32
name: load_slot_file_tables
description: Builds a file name from a letter derived from the argument, then opens that file from a path chosen by a flag. When the file opens it copies several fixed-size state tables from it; otherwise it takes an alternate path, then loops on a selection routine until a valid choice is returned.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BF62
name: load_winpic_state_tables
description: Retries disk access in a loop, then opens a file named from a slot letter and copies several fixed-size state tables from it. It closes the file and, when a flag is clear, resets several state bytes and words before finishing.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BF8E
name: load_slot_with_disk_prompt
description: Keeps trying to open a slot file while showing the referenced prompt and abort messages through a text routine. When the file opens it copies the fixed-size state tables and resets state fields when a flag is clear.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BFAE
name: retry_load_slot_file
description: Polls disk status in a loop, and when a slot file opens it copies the fixed-size state tables and resets state fields. A failed open sets a status code and retries.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BFB0
name: copy_slot_file_tables
description: Opens the slot file named from a letter, copies the fixed-size state tables from it when it opens, and closes it. It resets several state fields when a flag is clear, then restores the display.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:BFDA
name: load_slot_tables_direct
description: Opens the slot file without a retry loop, copies the fixed-size state tables from it, and closes it. It resets several state fields when a flag is clear before restoring the display.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C0BA
name: finish_save_game_with_error
description: Shows the referenced game-save error message when its result is nonzero, then waits until the file operation completes. It resets several state fields when a flag is clear and restores the display.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C0DA
name: finish_load_game_with_error
description: Waits for a file operation to complete, then resets several state fields when a flag is clear and restores the display. Its referenced text is the game-load error message and the winpic file name.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C108
name: wait_disk_then_reset_state
description: Shows the referenced please-insert-game-disk message and repeats a file operation until it returns nonzero. It then resets several state fields when a flag is clear and restores the display.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C118
name: reset_state_fields_and_redraw
description: When a flag is clear, resets several state bytes and words, makes calls that set a value and clear two fields, then issues the final library call on the display record. With the flag set it only makes that final library call.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C228
name: file_op_with_error_flag
description: Performs a file operation on the open handle with two arguments, either through a library function or an alternate routine depending on a flag. A negative result sets an error code in a global.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C24C
name: file_op_store_result_status
description: Calls a library file operation with the handle and two frame arguments and stores the returned value in the frame. It sets a global error code when that value is negative.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C276
name: set_rectangle_entry_around_point
description: Stores four 16-bit edge values into a 12-byte table entry chosen by index, placing the edges 250 to the left and right of the given x and 200 above and below the given y.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C2D0
name: advance_scene_setup_sequence
description: Runs a fixed sequence of library and routine calls that redraw a display and set several state fields, then advances a counter. It also adds three to each of six bytes in a state table.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C3F8
name: animate_winpic_palette_steps
description: Loads a colour table for the referenced winpic image, then loops through steps that copy shifted windows of the table into a 32-byte buffer. Each step applies random or fixed scaling, sets the palette through a library call, and waits.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C4B8
name: fade_palette_steps_loop
description: Loop form of the palette step animation: it clears the working colour buffer, copies shifted colour windows into it, applies random or fixed bias values, sets the palette and waits. It ends by reloading the base palette.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C4E4
name: fade_palette_steps_inner
description: Palette step animation that rebuilds each 32-byte colour buffer from a shifted window, applies a bias from a random source or fixed values, and sets the palette with a delay per step. It ends by reloading the base palette.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C574
name: select_size_by_flag_byte
description: Returns 10 when a byte from a table at the given index is nonzero, and 8 otherwise.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C586
name: select_position_offset_call
description: Returns a 2-bit state value. When that value is zero or a state byte exceeds 97, it calls a routine with coordinates from a global position offset by 200 when a flag word is nonzero; otherwise it passes fixed coordinates of 100.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C59A
name: call_routine_at_position
description: Returns a 2-bit state value. When that value is zero or a state byte exceeds 97, it calls a routine with coordinates derived from a global position, using fixed coordinates of 100 when the index is eight or more.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C5EE
name: call_routine_with_fixed_position
description: Calls one routine with the constants 100, 100, 100 and 1 plus a fixed buffer address, then returns.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C610
name: dispatch_actor_action_mode
description: Dispatches on an action code for a stored actor record. Some codes issue routine calls at the actor's position, one compares the absolute distance to a target to choose between two calls, one sets a random value from 0 to 7, and others pick a target from a table; each code also updates the actor's state byte.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C630
name: dispatch_actor_action_alt
description: Action-code dispatcher for an actor record that matches the main dispatcher but gates some routine calls on a random check drawn from a library call. It stores the action code and updates the actor's state byte.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C662
name: update_actor_distance_state
description: Handles the proximity and state cases of the actor action dispatcher. Code 8 compares the absolute distance to a target and may raise the state byte to 24, codes 4 and 10 set it to 12, and code 2 sets a flag when the index matches a stored target.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C694
name: run_actor_action_when_flagged
description: Action-code dispatcher for an actor that makes its routine calls only when a flag argument is nonzero. Code 4 stores a random value from 0 to 7, and codes 2 and 6 pick a table target before calling a routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C740
name: call_through_and_return
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns, with no other operations.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C760
name: dispatch_actor_action_short
description: Action-code dispatcher for an actor record covering codes 2 to 6 and 10, without the distance case. Code 4 stores a random value from 0 to 7 and sets the state byte to 12, codes 2 and 6 pick a table target before calling a routine, and code 10 sets the state byte to 12.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C784
name: dispatch_actor_action_no_random
description: Action-code dispatcher for an actor covering codes 2, 3, 5, 6 and 10 only. Codes 2 and 6 pick a table target and call a routine, and code 10 sets the state byte to 12 and calls a routine when a flag is set.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C7B2
name: dispatch_actor_targets_only
description: Action-code dispatcher for codes 2, 5, 6 and 10. Codes 2 and 6 pick a table target before calling a routine, and code 10 sets the state byte to 12.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C7E0
name: dispatch_actor_code_subset
description: Action-code dispatcher for an actor covering codes 2, 6 and 10. Codes 2 and 6 pick a table target before calling a routine when a flag is set, code 2 also sets a flag when the index matches a stored target, and code 10 sets the state byte to 12.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C83A
name: dispatch_actor_codes_six_ten
description: Action-code dispatcher for codes 6 and 10. Code 6 picks a table target and calls a routine when a flag is set, and code 10 calls a routine when that flag is set and sets the state byte to 12.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C852
name: call_table_target_when_flagged
description: When a flag argument is nonzero, it picks a table target and calls a routine with it, then returns.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C896
name: dispatch_code_ten_state
description: When the action code is 10, it calls a routine if a flag argument is nonzero, then stores 12 into a state byte of the actor record.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C8C4
name: subtract_counter_and_trigger
description: Subtracts the argument from a 16-bit counter. When the counter goes negative it clamps the counter to zero and calls a routine with the value 13; otherwise it calls a routine with a global.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C8E6
name: print_yum_message
description: Passes the referenced text, which reads as Yum!, to the output routine and returns.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:C920
name: locate_and_load_record_rows
description: Opens a data file with a fixed identifier and finds a matching record in a table by comparing it with a global key. It then reads rows of the matched block at offsets and a stride taken from the record, and returns one on success or zero when the file or match is missing.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:CBBA
name: advance_counter_and_flag
description: Clears a flag byte in the given structure and adds a 16-bit field to a 32-bit counter at a fixed offset. When the first byte was zero, it calls one routine four times.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:CBE6
name: interpret_script_commands
description: Interprets a byte-coded script stream. Opcode 129 loads a table value, 144 sets a field from the operand, and 255 with a zero operand ends the script while a nonzero operand jumps back to a saved position. Other bytes set a timing value from a table and, when the timing expires, store the next stream byte into a state field.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:CF02
name: decrement_counter_and_update_state
description: Writes a fixed word to two fields of an object record, then decrements a byte counter in the second argument when it is nonzero. When that counter reaches zero it writes two more fields, and it always sets one field to a fixed flag value when the counter was nonzero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:CF38
name: start_audio_channel_one
description: Starts audio channel 1 by writing a sample pointer, length and period from the arguments to its registers, setting its volume to 64, clearing its interrupt request, enabling its interrupt, and turning on DMA for that channel.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:CF8C
name: silence_audio_channel_one
description: Clears a flag bit in a state byte, then sets audio channel 1's volume to zero and its period to 2.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:CFB8
name: store_four_longs_in_globals
description: Stores four 32-bit arguments into four fixed fields of the global data area.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:CFDE
name: init_audio_channel_state
description: Initialises audio state by storing four arguments in two fields each, zeroing the volume registers of all four audio channels, and copying four words from a table entry into state fields. It clears further state fields and enables DMA for all four channels.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D09A
name: mute_all_audio_channels
description: Zeroes the volume of all four audio channels, sets a state byte to 255, and disables DMA for channels zero to three.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D0C0
name: install_music_vblank_interrupt
description: Sets up interrupt server and vector entries that name audio and music vblank handlers, installs them through the exec library's add-server and set-vector calls, and writes the interrupt enable and request registers for audio.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D16A
name: remove_music_vblank_interrupt
description: Removes the music vblank interrupt server through the library, clears the audio interrupt enable bit in the custom chip, and restores the previous interrupt vector through the library's set-vector call.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D19A
name: clear_block_and_store_values
description: Zeroes a block of 947 longwords starting at an offset derived from a global index, stores a register value and a global into two fields of that block, then calls a routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D1E4
name: return_without_action
description: An empty routine whose pseudo-code is a bare return with no operations.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D1EA
name: open_dos_and_parse_arguments
description: Opens dos.library through the library base and returns early if it is missing. Otherwise it scans a text buffer into space-separated arguments, keeping quoted arguments together, builds a pointer array to them, and opens a file with a fixed identifier.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D4DC
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination until a null terminator is reached or the count runs out, then fills any remaining bytes of the count with zeros.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D4FE
name: append_string_bounded
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most 32766 bytes. It writes a null terminator after the copied text when the source was cut short.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D504
name: copy_string_with_limit
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, stopping at a null terminator or when the counter in the third argument expires. If the counter expires first it writes a null terminator after the copied bytes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D528
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies a source string into a destination buffer including its terminator, and returns the destination pointer.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D538
name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values using their 16-bit halves, producing the low 32 bits of the product in the high half of the returned 64-bit value. The second operand is passed through in the low half.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D55C
name: apply_sign_to_result
description: Calls a routine on the register operands, then negates its result when exactly one of the two inputs is negative. It returns the result together with the second operand.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D584
name: negate_result_if_first_negative
description: Calls a routine, then negates the value it leaves in the second register when the first input is negative, returning that value with the first operand.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D59E
name: call_and_return_concatenated
description: Calls a routine and returns a 64-bit value built from the original second register and the value the call leaves in that register.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D5AA
name: self_recursive_call
description: Contains only a call to itself followed by a return, so each invocation recurses without a base case.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D5B4
name: divide_32_bit_with_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor and returns the quotient and remainder in a 64-bit value. It uses 16 shift-and-subtract steps when the divisor exceeds 16 bits and two 16-bit divisions otherwise.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D604
name: compute_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated string to its terminator and returns its length, without changing memory.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D616
name: call_optional_hook_then_routine
description: Calls a stored hook routine if its pointer is set, then calls another routine and returns.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D634
name: finish_stored_value_cleanup
description: Calls one routine 20 times, invokes a stored hook if one is set, and calls routines on up to three stored values. It then either passes two stored values to routines and returns the result of a further call, or passes one stored value to a routine and returns its argument.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D6E8
name: free_table_entry_by_index
description: Checks that a table index is in the range 0 to 19 and that the entry is in use, otherwise setting error code 3 and returning minus one. For a valid entry it releases the stored pointer through a library call when the entry's flag bit is clear, clears the entry, and returns zero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D738
name: call_library_vector_36
description: Calls the library function at offset minus 36 from the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D774
name: call_library_vector_132
description: Calls the library function at offset minus 132 from the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_48
description: Calls the library function at offset minus 48 from the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D846
name: call_library_vector_414
description: Calls the library function at offset minus 414 from a second library base kept in a different global variable, then returns.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D856
name: allocate_slot_request_block
description: Reserves a free slot index through a helper, then allocates a 34-byte block with public and cleared flags. It fills the block's fields from the arguments, a type code and the slot, and passes it to a second routine. It returns the block, or zero when no slot or memory is available.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D8E2
name: release_allocated_block
description: Releases a block allocated for a slot. It calls a routine on the block when its pointer field is set, marks its state as 255 and clears its slot field, then makes a library call to free the 34-byte block after a further routine call.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D940
name: call_stored_function_48
description: Passes its argument and the value 48 to a function pointer kept in a global variable, then returns.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D956
name: call_stored_function_with_arg
description: Passes its argument to a function pointer kept in a global variable, then returns.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D968
name: allocate_typed_block_if_requested
description: Returns zero when the first argument is zero. Otherwise it allocates a cleared block through a library call, sets a type byte to 5, stores the argument in a pointer field, and returns the block, or zero if the allocation failed.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D9AC
name: reset_block_and_release
description: Returns zero for a null block. Otherwise it marks the block's state as 255, sets two fields to minus one, and returns the result of a stored function call on the block and its size field.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D9C0
name: reset_block_state_fields
description: Marks a block's state byte as 255, sets two of its fields to minus one, and calls a stored function on the block.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:D9E8
name: call_library_vector_198
description: Calls the library function at offset minus 198 from the library base kept in a second global variable, then returns.

name: setup_pointer_chain
description: Sets up a self-referencing pointer chain in a block: the first longword becomes the block's own address plus four, the next longword is cleared, and the third stores the block's address.
